yipyy-pay.disconnected: Your payment account is no longer connected. This happens if the app was removed from your merchant account.
yipyy-pay.cardPaymentsDown: Card payments are not working right now.
yipyy-pay.lastSyncNote: The last check for changes made at Clover was {when}. It normally runs every 15 minutes.
yipyy-pay.pendingUpdatesOne: One update from Clover has been received but not applied.
yipyy-pay.pendingUpdatesMany: {count} updates from Clover have been received but not applied.
yipyy-pay.refundsMayNotReach: Refunds made in Clover may not be reaching Yipyy
yipyy-pay.moneyOnItsWay: Money on its way to your bank
yipyy-pay.moneyOnItsWayHelp: Estimated from the card payments you have taken. Clover settles the final amount.
yipyy-pay.nothingSettling: Nothing is waiting to settle. Card payments you take today will appear here with the date they should reach your bank.
yipyy-pay.noPaymentsYetHelp: Take one at checkout, or send a customer a payment link, and it will show up here with the booking it belongs to.
yipyy-pay.readersFailed: Your card readers could not be listed. This usually means the payment account needs reconnecting.
yipyy-pay.noReaderYetHelp: You can already take payments online — a payment link or an emailed invoice needs no hardware. A card reader is for taking the card in front of you at the counter.
yipyy-pay.modelNotDrivable: This model cannot be driven from a web app. A Clover Flex, Mini or Compact can.
yipyy-pay.tippingAtReaderHelp: Your readers ask for a tip during the sale, using the tiers set in Yipyy. There is nothing to push to a device — change the tiers and the next payment uses them.
yipyy-pay.addingReaderHelp: You do not pair a reader with Yipyy. It belongs to your payment account, and it appears here on its own once it is running.
yipyy-pay.nameReadersHelp: Give each reader a name as soon as it appears — “Front desk”, “Grooming room”. Two readers of the same model are otherwise told apart only by their serial, and picking the wrong one sends the card request to another room.
yipyy-pay.nameThisReaderHelp: Staff pick a reader by this name at checkout. Say where it is.
yipyy-pay.name: Name
yipyy-pay.customerSeesShortHelp: The name Yipyy prints on receipts, invoices and payment emails.
yipyy-pay.feeCost: Card payments cost {reader} on your reader and {online} online.
yipyy-pay.statementNoteShort: The line on your customer's bank statement is separate. It belongs to your merchant account and is changed there.
yipyy-pay.passOnNotReadyShort: Passing the fee on is not switched on yet.
yipyy-pay.estimateNoteShort: This setting changes the dates Yipyy estimates, not your schedule.
yipyy-pay.tippingHelp: Tip tiers, prompts and reminders live in their own screen so there is only one place to change them.
yipyy-pay.preauthHelp: Place a small temporary hold to check a card is good before the appointment.
yipyy-pay.whenPaidShortHelp: Set on your merchant account. Tell us which one you are on and we will estimate arrival dates.
yipyy-pay.paymentsFailed: The payments could not be read.
yipyy-pay.sellingOneCheckoutBody: Terminal, online invoice and payment link all settle to the same account and land on the same booking.
yipyy-pay.sellingTipsBody: On-screen tipping at the terminal, tied to the booking and the staff who did the work.
yipyy-pay.sellingFollowBody: Every card payment and refund is on the booking it belongs to, so the day reconciles itself.
yipyy-pay.sellingOwnBody: The merchant account is in your business name and payouts go straight to your own bank. Yipyy never holds your funds and never sees a card number.
yipyy-pay.draftHeadline: Your application is still a draft
yipyy-pay.submittedBody: We check it over, then pass it to the provider who opens your merchant account. You do not need to do anything.
yipyy-pay.reviewBody: This is the part that takes the longest and it is out of our hands. If anything more is needed, it will appear here.
yipyy-pay.moreInfoBody: Underwriting has come back with a question. Answer it and your application carries on from where it was.
yipyy-pay.approvedBody: One step left: link it to Yipyy so payments can start reaching your bookings.
yipyy-pay.rejectedBody: The reason is below. You can start a new application once whatever it names has been dealt with.
yipyy-pay.payoutStandardHelp: Money reaches your bank two to three business days after you take it.
yipyy-pay.payoutNextDayHelp: Available on some accounts once you have been trading a while. Check your Clover account.
yipyy-pay.needLegalNameDetail: Exactly as your tax records show them — capitalisation, punctuation and any Inc., Ltd. or LLC included.
yipyy-pay.needPhotoIdDetail: Passport, driving licence or national ID card, plus their date of birth, home address and identity number.
yipyy-pay.needBankDetail: In the business name, not a personal account, with a void cheque or bank letter to prove it.
yipyy-pay.needTerminalDetail: A Clover Flex, Mini or Compact. You can apply without one and add it later.
yipyy-pay.stepYouSubmitDetail: Your application is locked so it cannot change under review.
yipyy-pay.stepUnderwritingDetail: They check the business, the owners and the documents. They may come back with a question.
yipyy-pay.stepAccountOpenedDetail: In your business name, with payouts to the account you gave.
yipyy-pay.stepLinkedDetail: Then terminal, link and invoice payments all land on the booking they belong to.
yipyy-pay.neverSwept: Nothing has ever checked this connection for changes made at Clover.
yipyy-pay.stillSettingUpWhy: Until the country and currency are settled, a card cannot be charged — Yipyy refuses rather than guessing, because guessing wrong charges a customer in the wrong money.
yipyy-pay.testAccountSimulated: Cards are simulated, no money reaches your bank, and the figures below are not real takings.
yipyy-pay.applicationProgress: {done} of {total} sections finished. Nothing you have entered is lost.
yipyy-pay.legalNameWarningWhy: Capitalisation, punctuation and any Inc., Ltd. or LLC included. A mismatch is the most common reason a payment account sits waiting, and it is the easiest one to avoid.
yipyy-pay.alreadyHaveAccount: Already take card payments through a Clover merchant account?
yipyy-pay.applyIntro: What we need to open a merchant account for {facility}. Each step saves on its own — leave whenever you like and come back to it.
yipyy-pay.holdingHelpWhy: Your identity documents and the identity and account numbers you gave are encrypted, readable only by you and the Yipyy administrator handling this application, and deleted once your merchant account is open. The business details stay, because they are what the account is registered against.
yipyy-pay.setupIntro: Three steps to start taking card payments at {facility}. You can leave at any point and pick up where you stopped.
yipyy-pay.linkedToMerchant: Yipyy Pay is linked to your merchant account.
yipyy-pay.linkedToMerchantId: Yipyy Pay is linked to your merchant account {id}.
yipyy-pay.neverSeesPassword: Yipyy never sees your merchant password. You are signing in to an account you already hold, and nothing about it is typed here.
yipyy-pay.feeRates: Card payments cost {terminal} on your terminal and {online} online.
yipyy-pay.locationsOnAccount: You have {count} locations on this account.
yipyy-pay.reconnectFromPreferences: Reconnect from Preferences to start taking cards again.
yipyy-pay.totalsMayMissRefunds: Payment totals on this page may be missing refunds until this is resolved.
yipyy-pay.readersOnAccountOne: 1 reader on your account. Clover keeps this list — buy or return one there and it changes here.
yipyy-pay.readersOnAccountMany: {count} readers on your account. Clover keeps this list — buy or return one there and it changes here.
yipyy-pay.switchingReplaces: Switching replaces it — payments already taken stay where they were taken.
yipyy-pay.passOnNotReadyWhy: It changes what a customer is charged, so the invoice, the receipt and the refund all have to agree about it — and whether it is allowed at all differs by country and by state. Yipyy Pay absorbs it into your takings until then.
yipyy-pay.preauthUnavailableWhy: A pre-authorisation is a card charge that is deliberately not final, and Canadian card processing refuses those. Yipyy also has no card vault to hold against yet. This is here so you know it has been looked at, not forgotten.
yipyy-pay.connectStep1: You go to Clover, who hold the merchant account.
yipyy-pay.connectStep2: You sign in there with your own merchant email and password.
yipyy-pay.connectStep3: You approve what they ask for — reading your devices, and taking payments.
yipyy-pay.connectStep4: You come straight back here, connected.
yipyy-pay.whatYipyyCollects: Yipyy collects your identity documents, identity numbers and bank account number, encrypts them, and passes them to the provider who opens your merchant account. Only you and the Yipyy administrator handling your application can open them, and they are deleted once the account is open. Only the last four digits of any number are ever shown back to you.
yipyy-pay.byServiceHint: What the money was for. Clover cannot answer this — the booking can.
yipyy-pay.setupResumeBody: — you are on step {step} of 3. Nothing you have done is lost.
